Chapter 5
Implementation
5.1
Introduction
This chapter describes the implementation of the Intelligent Research Assistant. The
system has been developed using Python and FastAPI with a modular architecture.
Each functionality is implemented as an independent module, making the system scal-
able, maintainable, and easy to extend. The project integrates secure authentication,
document management, semantic search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and
citation generation into a unified research platform.
The implementation follows a layered architecture consisting of the Presentation
Layer, Business Logic Layer, AI Processing Layer, and Data Storage Layer.
5.2
